# LegalRecovery.in — B2B & Institutional Legal Discovery Index

- [Advocate-Vetted Loan Recall cum Personal/Corporate Guarantee Invocation Notice Template (RBI Penal-Charge Compliant)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/bank-loan-recall-cum-guarantee-invocation-notice): Interactive pre-DRT bank loan recall & Contract Act ss.126/128 guarantee invocation notice template with uncompounded RBI Penal-Charges Schedule A and Word (.doc) export.
- [NBFC SARFAESI Eligibility Decoded: ₹100 Cr Asset / ₹20 Lakh Debt Rule & LAP Alternatives](https://www.legalrecovery.in/nbfc-sarfaesi-eligibility-100-crore-asset-20-lakh-loan-rule): Statutory analysis of MoF Notifications S.O. 856(E) and S.O. 652(E) under SARFAESI s.2(1)(m)(iv), HFC ₹1 Lakh floor, and fast-track Arbitration s.21/s.9/s.36 mortgage enforcement for non-SARFAESI NBFCs.

- [RBI Recovery Agent Directions & Digital Lending Compliance: Replacing Telecalling Liability with Audit-Safe Legal Notices](https://www.legalrecovery.in/rbi-recovery-agent-guidelines-compliant-legal-escalation-nbfc): Operational compliance playbook for NBFCs and LSPs to replace 8 AM–7 PM telecalling liability with BSA 2023 s.63-verified tri-channel Advocate Legal Notices.

- [Unit-Economics Playbook for Small-Ticket Fintech & BNPL Defaults (₹5,000–₹1,00,000)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/small-ticket-digital-personal-loan-bnpl-recovery-economics): Unit-positive 3-wave recovery playbook combining BSA s.63 digital advocate notices, 30-day CICRA pre-adverse reporting alerts, selective Speed Post RPAD, and Section 29B batch ODR arbitration.

- [RBI-Compliant Gold Loan Default & Public Auction Protocol for NBFCs (Contract Act s.176)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/gold-loan-default-auction-statutory-notice-rbi-compliance-nbfc): Step-by-step NBFC compliance playbook for 75% LTV margin calls, non-waivable Section 176 registered pre-auction notices, 14-day vernacular newspaper ads, taluka-level auctions, and surplus/deficit settlement.
- [Commercial Vehicle & Construction Equipment Finance Recovery for NBFCs](https://www.legalrecovery.in/commercial-vehicle-construction-equipment-finance-recovery-nbfc): Institutional NBFC playbook for pre-seizure loan recall, Arbitration Act Section 9 ex-parte Court Receiver orders, Vahan Form 36 RC transfer under MV Act s.51(5), and post-sale Loss-on-Sale deficit suits.
